title: I didn't like Blade Runner. Should I rewatch it?

commenti.body:
It’s important to watch it on a big screen, and loud (headphones work!).

Scott tells his story with the images, not the dialogue. This is not for everyone - it took me 3x to get it, some people won’t ever and that’s fine. The 3rd time was at the theater. 

Every detail of those long shots tells part of the story. The lighting, the set decoration, the vibe in the air, the way people stand, and the way they talk. 

The dialogue fills in the details to an extent, but largely this is a movie to be read, visually.

You 100% should rewatch it. One of the best movies ever made. It can take a time or two to get into it.

If you need some assistance with all the thematic stuff, [this literary analysis](https://filmcolossus.com/blade-runner-1982-explained) is a good way to understand the meaning and everything. That can help improve the viewing experience.
I didn’t enjoy the movie, but I did enjoy the novel it was based on, Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? Maybe reading the novel before watching the movie again will help you enjoy the story.

You don’t have to. If you didn’t enjoy it the first time, well. Aging out of films for kids happens, unfortunately. Our small town didn’t have Blade Runner or Star Wars on VHS. I missed my enjoyment window of opportunity. It’s also sad to think of watching Blade Runner due to the unfortunate story of Sean Young’s career. I’m a cinephile with zero interest in watching Blade Runner at 40. If you don’t want to, don’t feel obliged.
